name: Crop PDF Margins Visually

seo.title: Crop PDF Margins Visually — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Preview PDF pages and set crop boxes using explicit point/mm/inch margins without rasterizing page content.

assumptions: Cropping changes the visible crop box; underlying content outside the crop can remain in the file.
limitations: Cropping is not redaction. Hidden content outside the crop box may still be recoverable.
